experiment: search for a deployable teaching-side unseen-word type signal
question: Can any signal legitimately present in the teaching turns classify an unseen subject (near/far) while rejecting foil/negative?

arms.A0: production baseline (recorded focused live; recomputed near/far from flags)
arms.A1: GloVe item-own category centre over candidate words (deployable control)
arms.A3: char-3gram fast-mapping between query subject and taught r2 (deployable)

method.permutation: 2 deterministic hash shuffles; any changed pick -> None
method.gold_use: graded only, after A0-A3 scoring; A4 reads the key by design
method.teaching_source: regenerated with scripts/tra_items.py::teaching_surface (recorded rows carry empty teaching_surfaces)

oracle_audit.note: A4 reads world_model (gold) because the query subject's own type_set deliberately excludes the taught slot label; a candidate-side membership key is what solves the ceiling.
